SIZZLE KITCHEN · FIRST PERSON

Your kitchen. Your hands.

Grab ingredients from the crates, build dishes on the island, work the oven and griddle, then ring the bell at the window. Customers walk up and take their food. Watch out for rushes, fires, food critics and empty crates.

🍕 Pizza

Dough → sauce → mozzarella → toppings on the pizza board. Carry it to the oven, take it out, and serve it at the window.

🍔 Burger

Raw patty from the fridge onto the griddle. Stack bun, cooked patty, toppings and top bun on the burger board, then serve.
